subject: Operational Bridge: 30/60/90 Ramp and Owner Commitments
messages:
From: Riley Morgan <riley@starlite.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: asha.patel@starlite.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps — aligning launch window and owners

Thanks Lauren — great demo yesterday. We want a short, actionable plan that our ops and engineering leads can follow. High level asks from our side: a firm go-live date target (we're aiming end of Q1), the 30/60/90 milestones, and a clear owner for each milestone (integration, data export, security acceptance, and launch readiness).

Can you send a tight list of owners and dates so we can prep procurement and internal rollout? Procurement will also need a redline-able SOW and a list of required evidence for our compliance review.

Quick answers welcome — Riley

--
Riley Morgan
Director, Platform Integrations
Starlite Health

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Riley Morgan <riley@starlite.ai>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@starlite.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Operational Bridge: 30/60/90 Ramp and Owner Commitments

Thanks Riley — attaching a concise Operational Bridge pack that pulls together the 30/60/90 milestones, owner rosters, and the SOW draft for Procurement. High-level proposal below and attachments: STL-SOW-v1.pdf (redline-able), 30-60-90-ramp-cadence.xlsx, Operational-Bridge-slide-deck.pptx.

Proposed timeline (tentative target: 2027-03-31 go-live):
- Week 0–4 (30d): Project kickoff, network & access provisioning, data schema alignment. Owners: Redwood (Ben Carter - integration), Starlite (Riley - product owner).
- Day 31–60: End-to-end integration tests, KV cache verification, tokenization samples, performance baseline. Owners: Redwood (Monica Patel - delivery lead), Starlite (Asha - eng lead).
- Day 61–90: Security acceptance tests, runbook rehearsal, stakeholder UAT and cutover dry-run. Owners: Redwood (Karthik Iyer - security/ops liaison), Starlite (Riley/Asha co-leads).

Critical dependencies for the plan to hold:
- Procurement sign-off on SOW (please confirm timeline).
- Customer access to a staging dataset and the staging VPC by 2026-12-08.
- Confirmation of SLA tier (dedicated vs hosted) — impacts provisioning lead times.

Immediate asks from Starlite:
1) Confirm go/no-go for target go-live on 2027-03-31 by 2026-12-10.
2) Procurement point-of-contact for SOW redlines.
3) Access window for a 2-week staging dataset transfer.

If this looks good I'll schedule a 30-minute alignment call next Tuesday to lock owners and deadlines.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0143

Subject: Re: Operational Bridge: 30/60/90 Ramp and Owner Commitments

Appreciate the crisp plan — thanks Lauren. A few clarifying notes from engineering: we need the expected data extract format (CSV vs parquet), the staging VPC CIDR range for firewall allowlisting, and an outline of the KV cache sizing assumptions so we can estimate cost and infra changes.

Procurement contact: procurement@starlite.ai (I copied them on a separate thread). They expect the SOW redlines within 5 business days once we receive the draft invoice summary.

We can confirm go-live target by 2026-12-09 once we lock the data-transfer window. Staging dataset window: tentative 2026-12-20 to 2027-01-03. That should give Redwood time to validate.

Asha
Senior Engineering Manager
Starlite Health

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Riley Morgan <riley@starlite.ai>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@starlite.ai>, procurement@starlite.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational Bridge: 30/60/90 Ramp and Owner Commitments — next steps

Great — thanks for the quick turn, Asha. Notes and next steps:
- We'll deliver a short technical appendix (data extract spec + CIDR notes + KV sizing assumptions) by Monday 2026-11-30. Ben will own the appendix.
- Monica will provision the staging instance once we have the dataset window; target staging provisioning: 2026-12-15.
- Karthik will assemble the acceptance test checklist for Security to sign off; expected delivery 2026-12-22.
- Lauren (me) will consolidate all redlines and produce a final SOW package for procurement review by 2026-12-06.

Action items for Starlite:
- Procurement: confirm a redlines POC and preferred DocuSign contact (procurement@starlite.ai is a good start).
- Engineering: confirm parquet vs csv and share a sample extract by 2026-11-29.
- Product: confirm whether any additional GDPR / regional data handling constraints apply to the staging set.

I'll lock a Tuesday 30-minute alignment slot (2026-12-01 10:00 PT) and send a calendar invite; please flag conflicts. If everyone affirms the plan above we will treat the dates as committed and publish the milestone tracker.

Thanks — looking forward to moving to provisioning.

Lauren
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
